threat_event: Attacker takes over the Project Manager's mailbox through an adversary-in-the-middle phishing page and sends the medical office owner false remittance instructions for a progress payment
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Push MFA is not phishing-resistant; no alerts on new inbox or forwarding rules; owners were never told how the company changes bank details; pay apps carry bank details on the cover page
existing_controls: Push MFA; vendor spam filtering; cyber policy with a $25,000 social engineering sublimit
treatment_plan: Security keys for the Owner, Office Manager, and Project Manager; alerts on new forwarding and inbox rules; remove bank details from pay app cover pages; written remittance-change notice to every owner with a call-back procedure (P08)

threat_event: A spoofed or compromised supplier or subcontractor mailbox asks for a bank change, and the next ACH payment goes to the attacker
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Bank changes accepted by email and entered by one person with no call-back; the Owner releases batches without seeing changes; near miss in May 2026
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-02 vendor bank details; SYS-08; BP-02 subcontractor payments
treatment_plan: Call-back to a number already on file for every bank change; Owner approval of the change before the next batch; first payment to a changed account held 5 business days; monthly vendor-change report

threat_event: Attacker changes the company's EFT information in SAM so the FC-1 progress payment goes to a mule account
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No alert process when the SAM registration changes; the Owner's SAM password is also used for another site
treatment_plan: Unique password and security key on the Owner's government sign-in; monthly comparison of SAM banking details with the bank; Office Manager reviews every SAM update

threat_event: Owners or subcontractors act on fake remittance emails sent from a look-alike domain or from the company's own spoofed domain
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No DMARC record; no look-alike domain monitoring; owners have no standing notice about remittance changes
affected_asset_or_process: Company domain; owner and subcontractor relationships; BP-01
existing_controls: Vendor spam filtering (protects only the company's inbox)
treatment_plan: Publish DMARC and move it to reject after 30 days of reports; register the two most likely look-alike domains; remittance-change notice in every contract and on every pay app

threat_event: Password spraying or a phished password opens the shared bids mailbox, which has no MFA
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Shared password known to 5 people, unchanged since 2024; no MFA; it receives bid invitations and subcontractor quotes
treatment_plan: Convert to a shared mailbox reached only through named accounts with MFA (delegation); retire the shared password

threat_event: The company cannot reach Final Level 1 (Self) CMMC status and an SPRS affirmation before the DoD award, and loses the award
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No FCI scope, SSP, or self-assessment before this work; 13 of 17 FAR requirement rows not fully met (P03); no POA&M allowed at Level 1
treatment_plan: Close every Level 1 gap by 2026-11-30; self-assess against the SP 800-171A objectives; SPRS entry and the Owner's affirmation by 2026-12-15

threat_event: An inaccurate CMMC affirmation or Section 889 representation exposes the company to False Claims Act liability
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: SAM representations renewed without a documented inquiry; the FC-1 recorder shows the inquiry was incomplete; no evidence standard for affirmations
treatment_plan: Evidence binder for every affirmation and representation; counsel review before the Owner signs; re-check at each SAM renewal

threat_event: Covered video surveillance or telecommunications equipment is delivered or installed on a federal project
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No submittal screening; private-label products hide the manufacturer; subcontract has no Section 889 terms
affected_asset_or_process: FC-1 installed systems; future federal jobs
existing_controls: FC-1 submittal rejected 2026-07-28; compliant resubmittal approved 2026-08-07
treatment_plan: Section 889 check in submittal review with the actual manufacturer confirmed in writing; Section 889 rider in subcontracts

threat_event: FCI and owners' drawings end up on systems the company does not control (personal email, the AI tool trial) and are retained or used to train models
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Automatic forwarding allowed; no approved-tools list; AI tool on click-through terms that allow training
treatment_plan: Block automatic forwarding; approved-systems list in POL-04; no FCI in the AI tool until enterprise terms are signed (P10); print through the shared drive instead of personal email

threat_event: The AI bid assistant produces wrong quantities or prices that go into a fixed-price bid
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Takeoffs not checked against drawings for every trade; one user and no second reviewer
treatment_plan: Manual check of every AI takeoff for the 5 largest cost items; back-test against 5 past bids before relying on it (P10)

threat_event: A former employee or a subcontractor from a closed project still reaches email or project drawings
threat_source: Former workforce member or business partner
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No termination checklist; departed Superintendent active until 2026-07-21; 31 external users from closed projects
existing_controls: External users limited to their project
treatment_plan: Same-day termination checklist; remove external users at project closeout; quarterly user review

threat_event: A lost or stolen phone or tablet exposes drawings and email
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Phones and tablets not managed; one tablet has no passcode; no remote wipe
existing_controls: Devices kept in trucks or containers at night
treatment_plan: Enroll in device management with passcode, encryption, and remote wipe

threat_event: Ransomware or a malicious deletion wipes email and files, and the backup cannot restore them
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Backup never restore-tested; 30-day retention; one MSP administrator without MFA can delete it; desktop not encrypted
existing_controls: MSP antivirus and patching; daily backup
treatment_plan: Restore test by 2026-09-30; 90-day immutable retention; MFA on the backup console; monthly export of SYS-01 pay app packages and current drawings

threat_event: Compromise of the MSP remote management tool gives attackers control of every company computer
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No MSP security review; no incident notice term; MFA on the tool not evidenced
treatment_plan: Annual MSP security review (questionnaire and evidence of MFA); 24-hour incident notice term at the contract renewal

threat_event: Staff do not recognize or report a business email compromise, so the bank recall and notice clocks are missed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No training; no reporting rule before POL-03; insurer hotline not known
treatment_plan: Adopt POL-03 and the P08 runbook; reporting card on every phone; annual training; tabletop with the MSP

threat_event: The cyber insurer denies a funds transfer fraud claim because the company kept no record of call-back verification
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: The social engineering sublimit applies only when a call-back to a known number was made and recorded; no such record exists today
treatment_plan: Call-back log kept for every bank change (POL-02 A.6); confirm with the broker that the procedure meets the policy wording

threat_event: Certified payrolls with full Social Security numbers are exposed from a compromised mailbox
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Subcontractors email full payroll records to the Office Manager; attachments stay in the mailbox
treatment_plan: Subcontractors upload payrolls to SYS-01 instead of email; delete payroll attachments from the mailbox after filing

threat_event: A visitor's or subcontractor's infected laptop on the office Wi-Fi reaches company computers and the printer
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One Wi-Fi network for everyone; password unchanged since 2023; printer default password
existing_controls: Firewall blocks unsolicited inbound traffic from the internet
treatment_plan: Separate guest Wi-Fi with no route to company devices; change the staff Wi-Fi and printer passwords

threat_event: A retired laptop that was not wiped exposes FCI, drawings, or employee data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 3 laptops given away or recycled since 2024 with no wipe record
treatment_plan: MSP wipe record for every reused device; certificate of destruction for disposal

threat_event: A hurricane closes the office and jobsites for several days
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No contingency plan; one internet line; Office Manager is the only person who can run payroll
existing_controls: SaaS reachable from anywhere; jobsite hurricane plans for physical work
treatment_plan: 3-page contingency plan with a hurricane checklist; printed contact card; Owner trained to run payroll

threat_event: SYS-01 outage during pay app week or a bid deadline
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single SaaS dependency; no company export of project records
existing_controls: Vendor recovery commitments (SOC 2, RTO 4 h; P09)
treatment_plan: Accepted by the Office Manager: the vendor's RTO and RPO meet the BIA and printed sets cover a day. The monthly export under R-013 further reduces it

threat_event: The Office Manager is unavailable during an incident or at payroll time, and payments, payroll, and the MSP contact stall
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Only the Office Manager knows payroll, billing entry, the bank-change process, and the MSP contacts
existing_controls: Payroll service can repeat a prior payroll
treatment_plan: One-page procedures for payroll, ACH, and bank changes; Owner cross-trained; contact card shared

threat_event: A pricing feature in the AI tool pools the company's prices with competitors' data, putting its independent price determination on a federal bid at risk
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vendor terms unclear on cross-customer data use; a market pricing feature is on by default
treatment_plan: Turn off the market pricing feature; counsel confirms in writing before the next federal bid (P10)

threat_event: CUI-marked drawings arrive on the DoD job and are stored in systems that do not meet NIST SP 800-171
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No intake check for CUI markings; the company is not ready for CUI
existing_controls: No CUI expected in the DoD job
treatment_plan: CUI marking check at document intake; quarantine and Contracting Officer contact procedure (POL-04 4.2)
